Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure is a single labeled diagram of an upward-opening parabola drawn on a Cartesian coordinate plane, with thin black arrowed axes crossing near the lower left of the curve and marked x at the right and y at the top. The parabola is a heavy dark blue curve whose two branches end in arrowheads pointing up and outward. Its lowest point is a filled dark blue dot above the horizontal x-axis, connected by a short leader line to the label Vertex at the left. A dashed orange vertical line rises through that dot and carries the orange label Axis of symmetry at the upper right. Directly above the vertex on that same vertical line sits a small teal dot labeled Focus in teal. A short dashed blue horizontal segment runs through the teal dot from one branch of the curve to the other and is tagged Latus rectum by a curved arrow from the upper left. Below the vertex, a dashed red horizontal line spanning the width of the frame is labeled Directrix in red, and the x-axis lies lower in the frame. Color-coding the four named features separately lets the reader see that the axis of symmetry meets the directrix at a right angle and that the vertex lies midway between focus and directrix. The drawing establishes the vocabulary used to define a parabola as the set of points equally distant from the focus and the directrix.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Slider for changing the focus-directrix distance p: the learner drags p, the focus rises or falls with the directrix mirroring below the vertex and the blue parabola widens or narrows, making the equal-distance definition control the curve's shape.
- Toggle between labeled features and distance construction: the learner switches views, labels fade into perpendicular distance segments from a sample point to the focus and directrix, making clear why the vertex sits midway between them.
- Hover for individual parabola features: the learner hovers the vertex, focus, directrix, axis, or latus rectum, the selected feature brightens with its label and related construction lines, clarifying each vocabulary term without crowding the diagram.

SOURCE FILE: OpenStax Precalculus 2e, chapter 10: Analytic Geometry

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

Drag p to reshape the parabola. Toggle the construction to see a sample point's equal distances to the focus and directrix. Hover any colored feature for its definition.

// @FIGURE_CODE_BEGIN // [svgjs] Interactive parabola: focus/directrix definition (OpenStax Precalculus 10) var draw = SVG().addTo(document.getElementById('container')).size('100%', '100%'); var frame = setPlotFrame({ xDomain: [-2.6, 5.6], yDomain: [-2.6, 5.6], margin: 30, draw: draw }); // ---- parameters ---- var H = 1, K = 1; // vertex (h,k) var P = 0.8; // focus-directrix half-distance var showDist = false; function parabY(x) { return K + (x - H) * (x - H) / (4 * P); } function focusY() { return K + P; } function dirY() { return K - P; } // ---- color palette (matched to source) ---- var C_PARAB = '#16497f', C_AXIS = '#e07b28', C_FOCUS = '#159a9a', C_LATUS = '#2b7fd4', C_DIR = '#d43a3a', C_AXES = '#111'; // ---- helpers ---- function halo(t) { return t.attr({ 'paint-order': 'stroke', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 3, 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' }); } function mkText(str, color, size, anchor) { return halo(draw.text(str).font({ size: size || 13, family: 'Georgia, serif', anchor: anchor || 'start', style: 'italic' }).fill(color)); } function arrowHead(sx, sy, ang, size, color) { var a1 = ang + 2.6, a2 = ang - 2.6; var p1 = [sx + size * Math.cos(a1), sy + size * Math.sin(a1)]; var p2 = [sx + size * Math.cos(a2), sy + size * Math.sin(a2)]; return draw.polygon([sx + ',' + sy, p1[0] + ',' + p1[1], p2[0] + ',' + p2[1]]).fill(color); } function screenAngle(x1, y1, x2, y2) { return Math.atan2(plotY(y2) - plotY(y1), plotX(x2) - plotX(x1)); } // ---- persistent elements (created once, repositioned in render) ---- // axes var yAxis = draw.line().stroke({ color: C_AXES, width: 1.4 }); var xAxis = draw.line().stroke({ color: C_AXES, width: 1.4 }); var yArrT = arrowHead(0, 0, 0, 7, C_AXES), yArrB = arrowHead(0, 0, 0, 7, C_AXES), xArrR = arrowHead(0, 0, 0, 7, C_AXES), xArrL = arrowHead(0, 0, 0, 7, C_AXES); var xLab = mkText('x', C_AXES, 15), yLab = mkText('y', C_AXES, 15); // directrix var dirLine = draw.line().stroke({ color: C_DIR, width: 2, dasharray: '6,4' }); var dirLab = mkText('Directrix', C_DIR, 13); // axis of symmetry var axLine = draw.line().stroke({ color: C_AXIS, width: 2, dasharray: '6,4' }); var axLab = mkText('Axis of symmetry', C_AXIS, 13); // latus rectum var latLine = draw.line().stroke({ color: C_LATUS, width: 2, dasharray: '5,4' }); var latLab = mkText('Latus rectum', C_LATUS, 13); var latArrow = draw.path().fill('none').stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1 }); var latArrowHead = arrowHead(0, 0, 0, 5, '#333'); // parabola (auto re-sampled by scaffold on resize) var parab = plotFunction('parab', { fn: function (x) { return parabY(x); }, stroke: C_PARAB, width: 3.2 }); var pArrL = arrowHead(0, 0, 0, 9, C_PARAB), pArrR = arrowHead(0, 0, 0, 9, C_PARAB); // vertex + focus var vertexLeader = draw.line().stroke({ color: '#444', width: 1 }); var vertexDot = draw.circle(9).fill(C_PARAB); var vertexLab = mkText('Vertex', C_PARAB, 13); var focusDot = draw.circle(8).fill(C_FOCUS); var focusLab = mkText('Focus', C_FOCUS, 13); // distance construction group var gDist = draw.group(); var segFocus = gDist.line().stroke({ color: C_FOCUS, width: 1.6, dasharray: '4,3' }); var segDir = gDist.line().stroke({ color: C_DIR, width: 1.6, dasharray: '4,3' }); var sampleDot = gDist.circle(7).fill('#7a3fb0'); var lenF = halo(gDist.text('d').font({ size: 12, family: 'Georgia, serif', style: 'italic' }).fill(C_FOCUS)); var lenD = halo(gDist.text('d').font({ size: 12, family: 'Georgia, serif', style: 'italic' }).fill(C_DIR)); // ---- render: position everything from current P / toggle ---- function render() { var xd = frame.xDomain, yd = frame.yDomain; var fy = focusY(), dy = dirY(); // axes yAxis.plot(plotX(0), plotY(yd[0]), plotX(0), plotY(yd[1])); xAxis.plot(plotX(xd[0]), plotY(0), plotX(xd[1]), plotY(0)); yArrT.plot(plotX(0), plotY(yd[1]), -Math.PI / 2); yArrB.plot(plotX(0), plotY(yd[0]), Math.PI / 2); xArrR.plot(plotX(xd[1]), plotY(0), 0); xArrL.plot(plotX(xd[0]), plotY(0), Math.PI); xLab.move(plotX(xd[1]) - 4, plotY(0) - 18); yLab.move(plotX(0) + 8, plotY(yd[1]) - 2); // directrix dirLine.plot(plotX(xd[0] + 0.2), plotY(dy), plotX(xd[1] - 0.2), plotY(dy)); dirLab.move(plotX(xd[1] - 1.7), plotY(dy) - 18); // axis of symmetry axLine.plot(plotX(H), plotY(yd[1] - 0.3), plotX(H), plotY(yd[0] + 0.3)); axLab.move(plotX(H) + 8, plotY(yd[1] - 0.6)); // latus rectum var lx1 = H - 2 * P, lx2 = H + 2 * P; latLine.plot(plotX(lx1), plotY(fy), plotX(lx2), plotY(fy)); var lmx = plotX(H - 2 * P - 0.4), lmy = plotY(fy + 1.4); latLab.move(lmx - 70, lmy - 6); var targetX = plotX(H - 0.6 * P), targetY = plotY(fy); latArrow.attr('d', 'M ' + (lmx - 8) + ' ' + (lmy + 14) + ' Q ' + (lmx + 6) + ' ' + (lmy + 30) + ' ' + targetX + ' ' + (targetY - 4)); latArrowHead.plot(targetX, targetY, Math.PI / 2); // parabola arrowheads parab.sample(); var eL = xd[0] + 0.05, eR = xd[1] - 0.05; pArrL.plot(plotX(eL), plotY(parabY(eL)), screenAngle(eL + 0.2, parabY(eL + 0.2), eL, parabY(eL))); pArrR.plot(plotX(eR), plotY(parabY(eR)), screenAngle(eR - 0.2, parabY(eR - 0.2), eR, parabY(eR))); // vertex + focus vertexDot.center(plotX(H), plotY(K)); vertexLeader.plot(plotX(H) - 5, plotY(K), plotX(H - 1.5), plotY(K - 0.15)); vertexLab.move(plotX(H - 2.4), plotY(K - 0.15) - 7); focusDot.center(plotX(H), plotY(fy)); focusLab.move(plotX(H) + 9, plotY(fy) - 7); // distance construction var xs = H + 2.0, ys = parabY(xs); sampleDot.center(plotX(xs), plotY(ys)); segFocus.plot(plotX(xs), plotY(ys), plotX(H), plotY(fy)); segDir.plot(plotX(xs), plotY(ys), plotX(xs), plotY(dy)); lenF.center((plotX(xs) + plotX(H)) / 2 + 10, (plotY(ys) + plotY(fy)) / 2); lenD.center(plotX(xs) + 12, (plotY(ys) + plotY(dy)) / 2); gDist.attr('display', showDist ? '' : 'none'); // label fade in distance mode var lo = showDist ? 0.28 : 1; [vertexLab, focusLab, dirLab, axLab, latLab].forEach(function (t) { t.opacity(lo); }); } // ---- hover interactions ---- function attachHover(el, tip, on, off) { el.css('cursor', 'pointer'); el.on('mouseenter', function () { on(); }); el.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip(tip, e); }); el.on('mouseleave', function () { off(); hideTooltip(); }); } attachHover(vertexDot, 'Vertex: the lowest point of the parabola, midway between focus and directrix.', function () { vertexDot.attr('r', 12); }, function () { vertexDot.attr('r', 9); }); attachHover(focusDot, 'Focus: the fixed point; every parabola point is equidistant from it and the directrix.', function () { focusDot.attr('r', 11); }, function () { focusDot.attr('r', 8); }); attachHover(dirLine, 'Directrix: the fixed line; distance to it equals distance to the focus.', function () { dirLine.stroke({ width: 3.4 }); }, function () { dirLine.stroke({ width: 2 }); }); attachHover(axLine, 'Axis of symmetry: vertical line through vertex and focus; parabola mirrors across it.', function () { axLine.stroke({ width: 3.4 }); }, function () { axLine.stroke({ width: 2 }); }); attachHover(latLine, 'Latus rectum: chord through the focus, parallel to the directrix; length = 4p.', function () { latLine.stroke({ width: 3.4 }); }, function () { latLine.stroke({ width: 2 }); }); attachHover(parab.node, 'Parabola: set of points equidistant from the focus and the directrix.', function () { parab.node.attr('stroke-width', 4.4); }, function () { parab.node.attr('stroke-width', 3.2); }); // ---- control handlers ---- function update_p(v) { P = v; render(); } function toggle_dist(on) { showDist = on; render(); } document.addEventListener('fig-resize', render); render(); window.__markRendered(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
